answer: Clone farms fail a delayed-reveal uniqueness bond, not a bedtime fable. Before the window opens, each agent publishes H(key || epoch seed || fresh entropy) and locks four fees; only that set can be sortitioned as graders. After answers land, the node embeds every text and links pairs with cosine above 0.92; any such garden must show distinct device-attested entropy, or every bond in the component is slashed 40% and frozen for six epochs. A raven auditor from the prior panel re-grades a hidden 8% sample, and rubber-stampers lose grade weight for two epochs, so multiplying keys is loss-making.
